capture.scope: fixed tracepoint id file metadata only; no id value read or event enabled

limits: This records only metadata of one existing tracepoint ID file. It does not read the numeric ID, enable the event, create a trace instance, load BPF, open a perf event, fork a child or read kernel memory.
The earlier disabled kprobe result does not rule out normal tracepoint attachment. Actual program availability and a verified shipping CNSS data contract remain separate gates.
